FIELDS.NAME: CoolComfort HVAC Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
CoolComfort HVAC Solutions specializes in residential and light commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) sales, service, and installation. Our operations encompass a range of services including system diagnostics, routine maintenance, emergency repairs, and energy-efficient equipment installations. We pride ourselves on employing a team of licensed and certified HVAC technicians who are committed to ongoing training and professional development to stay current with the latest industry standards and technologies. 

By maintaining a written safety program and adhering to stringent safety protocols, we ensure a secure working environment for our employees and clients. We utilize EPA-compliant refrigerants and maintain meticulous records regarding refrigerant recovery and disposal to uphold our commitment to environmental responsibility. Our customer-centric approach includes using a CRM system to track service appointments, manage maintenance schedules, and address customer inquiries promptly. 

At CoolComfort HVAC Solutions, we are dedicated to delivering high-quality service while prioritizing safety, compliance, and customer satisfaction. We continuously assess our operational practices to ensure we maintain the highest standards in our work.
